top_signals.title: Trump Signals US Wants Distance From Iran War
top_signals.summary: President Donald Trump is playing down prospects for renewed Iran peace talks and broader US involvement even as Houthi activity adds another source of escalation to the conflict. Bloomberg News White House Correspondent Jeff Mason joins Bloomberg This Weekend to discuss President Trump's statements made during the Presidents trip to Ireland. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
